current_activity: first engaged against the US 3rd Armored Division on the approach to Paderborn
notes: Event date: 30 March 1945 (Wikipedia; MacDonald, ch. 16). Event definition: The brigade is first engaged against the 3rd Armored Division defending the approach to Paderborn; Task Force Richardson fights it in a town six miles short of the city (MacDonald, ch. 16; Wikipedia). Event support: two source families (the US Army official history (CMH), and Wikipedia). MacDonald, The Last Offensive, ch. 16, p. 352: "into a unit named SS Ersatzbrigade Westfalen"; Wikipedia, SS Brigade Westfalen: "The brigade was first engaged on 30 March against elements of US 3rd Armored Division". Location: Paderborn (new place); the action was about 10 km short of the city with a precision of 10 km. Location support: MacDonald gives a town six miles short of Paderborn; Wikipedia gives the way to Paderborn. Opponents: US 3rd Armored Division.

current_activity: relinquishes Paderborn late on 1 April and falls back with up to forty tanks and assault guns
notes: Event date: late on 1 April 1945 (MacDonald, ch. 16; Wikipedia). Event definition: The brigade finally relinquishes Paderborn to the 3rd Armored Division and falls back (MacDonald, ch. 16; Wikipedia). Event support: two source families (the US Army official history (CMH), and Wikipedia). MacDonald, The Last Offensive, ch. 16, p. 360: "which late on 1 April finally relinquished Paderborn to the American 3d Armored Division"; Wikipedia, SS Brigade Westfalen: "until forced to relinquish the town by 1 April". Location: Paderborn, North Rhine-Westphalia (new place) with a precision of 3 km. Location support: MacDonald and Wikipedia both name Paderborn. Opponents: US 3rd Armored Division.
